summary_for_children: Al-Falaq teaches seeking refuge in the Lord of daybreak from evil, darkness and envy.
environment_concept: A ridge facing the eastern horizon as daybreak comes, and a low hollow below it where the evening shadow settles. Lanterns light the hollow. No person, magic or envier is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Ridge-top lookout with low stone seats, a shaded hollow with lanterns.

areas.name: Daybreak Ridge
areas.description: A ridge where the sun is rising over the horizon, for reading 113:1.

areas.name: Settling Darkness
areas.description: A hollow where shadow gathers, lit by small lanterns you can light.

activities.name: Read the five
activities.description: Put the five ayahs of Al-Falaq in order.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the ridge and the hollow to the ayah each comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Light the hollow
activities.description: Tap the three lanterns in the hollow to light them.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A dark pine wood before dawn with old lanterns on posts along the path home

primary_mechanic.text: Light five lanterns in order along the path, holding still at each for the wick to catch (stepping to a later lantern first is noted); with each lantern the sky lightens from night toward daybreak (113:1, the Lord of daybreak). Nothing frightening is shown.

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading where the path enters the wood, the lanterns, then a reading at the edge of the wood
environment_behaviour: the sky brightens toward dawn with each lantern lit
unique_world.learning_objective: Seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (113:1)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Light of Daybreak
story_library.children_narration: When we feel afraid or uncertain, we can ask Allah for protection. Surah Al-Falaq teaches us to seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from different kinds of harm. It reminds us that we can turn to Allah in difficult moments.

world_idea.title: The Forest at Dawn
world_idea.description: Explore a quiet forest as morning approaches, with comforting narration and opportunities to learn the surah. Avoid frightening depictions of unseen harms.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
